largest.desc: List the largest files under the current directory, recursively.

oldfiles.desc: List files under the current directory that are older than the given number of days.

dirsummary.desc: Print the total file count and total size of the current directory.

print_command_output.desc: Print a command in bold blue, run it via eval, then print a divider.

function_list_all_table.desc: Scan functions/*.sh and print every function in a formatted Name|Description|Parameters|Example|File table.

get_absolute_path_windows.desc: Convert a path to its absolute Windows-style path (C:\...) via cygpath -w.

get_absolute_path_windows_forwardslashes.description_linemode_col: abs path, Windows w/ forward slashes
get_absolute_path_windows_forwardslashes.desc: Convert a path to its absolute mixed Windows path (C:/...) via cygpath -a -m.

get_absolute_path_unix.desc: Resolve a path to its absolute Unix-style path via readlink -f.

pwdw.desc: Print the current directory as a Windows path with backslashes (C:\Users\...).

pwdwb.desc: Wrapper around pwdw with the same output; usable as a callback for functions like copy.

pwdwf.description_linemode_col: pwd as Windows path, forward slashes
pwdwf.desc: Print the current directory as a Windows path with forward slashes (C:/Users/...).

create_symlink.desc: Create a native Windows symlink (ln -s -f -i -v); -f overwrites, -n handles dir-symlink targets.

create_symlink_interactively_with_fzf.desc: Prompt step-by-step (with tab/fzf path completion) for an original path and a link path, then create the symlink.

filetree.description_linemode_col: icon tree view of a directory
filetree.desc: Render a directory as a tree with folder/file icons and box-drawing connectors, directories sorted first.

copy.description_linemode_col: run a command, copy its stdout
copy.desc: Run the given command (including aliases) and pipe its stdout to the Windows clipboard.

copy_detailed.desc: Like copy, but also prints the command and up to 500 characters of its output.

push.desc: pushd to a directory (or the current one with no argument), remembering where you came from.

up.desc: Go up N directory levels at once (up 3 == cd ../../..).

popd_at_index.desc: Pop the directory stack (default: the top), or jump to and remove a specific stack index.

j.description_linemode_col: jump to an ancestor dir by name
j.desc: cd to a directory named <name> found anywhere in the current path, case-insensitively. Tab-completes.

x-copy-files-to-REPO.sh.desc: Dotfiles sync helper: copies modified config files/folders from your system into their matching git repos. Run from the directory containing the files to copy.

x-create-symlinks.sh.desc: Standalone wrapper around create_symlink_interactively_with_fzf; sources tools/file-management/fzf.sh so CTRL+T path search works.

x-lazygit-fix-corrupted-state.sh.desc: Deletes lazygit's state.yml under %LOCALAPPDATA%\lazygit, which can get corrupted if the machine crashes while Lazygit is open.

x-powertoys-run-install-plugin.sh.desc: Installs (optionally downloading from a GitHub release via gh) a PowerToys Run plugin into the PowerToys Run Plugins folder.

x-script-selector.sh.desc: The original fzf-based picker: lists BASH_SCRIPTS/**/*.sh and runs whichever one you select.

x-test-script.sh.desc: Demo script for testing what's available to a standalone script process (only exported vars/functions, per CLAUDE.md).

x-initialize-new-git-repo.sh.description_linemode_col: create + push a new private GitHub repo
x-initialize-new-git-repo.sh.desc: Initializes a new PRIVATE GitHub repo via the gh CLI, checks/prompts for gh auth, adds a README.md if missing, and copies .gitignore/.gitattributes from @SHARED_RESOURCES_REPO.

x-k8s-kube-info.sh.desc: Sources functions/_general-functions.sh and prints cluster-info, current-context, and all clusters/contexts/users.
